description: Defines a circular_map implementation with fixed and dynamic storage options, including traits for rebind, internal storage classes, iterators, and utility functions for circular indexing and element management.

classes.name: circular_map_impl
classes.description: A circular map container supporting fixed and dynamic storage, with iterator support and collision handling.

classes.name: iterator
classes.description: Forward iterator for circular_map_impl, skips absent elements.

classes.name: const_iterator
classes.description: Const version of iterator, skips absent elements.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element in-place if no collision.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an element if no collision, with lvalue or rvalue.

methods.name: overwrite
methods.description: Inserts or overwrites an element with the given key.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes element by key or iterator.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses element by key, with assertion.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Checks if map is at maximum capacity.

methods.name: has_space
methods.description: Checks if a key's slot is free.
